name: IncidentFlow (CLI)
shortDescription: Forensics evidence intake, chain of custody, hash verification and honest timelines.
features: Streamed SHA-256 intake with content-based duplicate detection
Hash verification with honest scope (integrity since collection, not authenticity)
Metadata-derived timelines labelled as non-chronological proof
knownLimitations: Not a forensic/legal admissibility tool (stated in-product)
Classic metadata only; no filesystem journaling
